purpose: Destination scenery painted into non-repeating background bitmaps

prompts.nature: Edit the reference children's book illustration into a production scenery prop, for baking into the existing painted backgrounds of a preschool walking timer. Keep the exact softly painted paper/grain and honey-brown wood of the reference's physical destination sign. Extract/redraw ONLY one small sturdy wooden trail marker: a rounded horizontal wooden signboard on one straight wooden post, with the exact Korean text "도착" hand-painted in dark forest green and one small carved golden star. A few tiny neutral grey pebbles at the foot anchor it to the ground. Remove the orange flag entirely. No animal, rabbit, character, landscape, sky, flowers, grass, frame, user interface, floating label, checkerboard line or new text. Front view, natural rounded painted edges, calm warm colors, full post base visible, compact portrait composition with generous fully transparent margin. Genuine transparent alpha background, no coloured backdrop and no cast glow. The post's base is the physical arrival position. This will be composited into a single background bitmap, not displayed as a UI icon. Preserve the reference's painterly look rather than a vector or glossy 3D look.
prompts.space: Use the supplied pixel space panorama as a style reference for a tiny destination landmark to bake into that same space backdrop. Generate ONLY one friendly orbital docking beacon: a vertical golden star-shaped portal ring with a small blue-grey pixel base, the center completely transparent so a horizontal rocket can fly through. Tiny fixed warm lights around the rim, restrained pastel gold and lavender, chunky clean 8-bit pixels matching the supplied navy nebula, no blur, no glow cloud. The exact short Korean word "도착" can be engraved on the small base in clear pixel lettering. No rocket, character, planets, stars scattered outside the object, background, grid, border, UI badge, flag or checkered finish. Centered complete portal, generous transparent padding, genuinely transparent alpha. This is a background scenery landmark, not an animated or floating UI overlay.
